description: Typologie de linéaire cyclable de Cergy - mai 2025 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Cergy. Ces équipements peuvent être visibles sur l'application cartographique de la Ville de Cergy: Cergy à Vélo Les aménagements cyclables sont désormais mieux identifiés grâce à la nouvelle méthodologie de comptage, qui prend en compte chaque tronçon, y compris dans les deux sens de circulation. Coverage: Ville de Cergy. The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Cergy. Its keywords include cergy, schema-cyclable, amenagements-cyclables, velo, pistes-cyclables. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
